title: Ajiro API project config (ajiro-api.yaml)
description: Project configuration created by `ajiro-api init`. Lives at the project root; `ajiro-api` searches parent directories for it.

version.description: Schema version of this file. Currently always 1.

framework.description: Framework to scan. Auto-detected by `init` when omitted.

sources.description: Source directories to scan, relative to the project root.

exclude.description: Glob-ish substrings of paths to exclude from scanning (e.g. `node_modules`, `dist`).

api_dir.description: Directory holding the endpoint YAML files.

env_file.description: Dotenv file holding secrets, referenced from YAML as `{{ env.NAME }}`. Keep it out of Git.

default_env.description: Environment used when `--env` is not given. Should be a key of `environments`.

redact.description: Extra header / JSON key names (case-insensitive) masked as `***` in logs and reports, in addition to the built-in ones.

timeout_ms.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Override with `ajiro-api test --timeout`.

base_url.description: Base URL of the running server. Override with `ajiro-api test --base-url`.

variables.description: Variables available as `{{ name }}` in endpoint files. Strings may use templates such as `{{ env.NAME }}`.

headers.description: Headers sent with every request in this environment. Templates are rendered per request, so they can use values captured by `setup` endpoints (e.g. `Cookie: "session={{ session }}"`). While `setup` runs, a header whose captured value does not exist yet is left out.

setup.description: Endpoint ids run before every other endpoint, with all their tests and their `depends_on` (e.g. a login that captures a session cookie). They run even when `test` is given a filter, their implicit smoke test is sent whatever the method, and a failure stops the run. Unknown ids are reported by `validate`.
